title: 第601章 古一的处境第600章 官品
lines: 正五品，比符台的一个符政使还低
沈知崖的声音原本温和，但语气突然多了一层不易察觉的冷意
“在古楼，称呼是有规矩的，正二品以上一般被称‘某台主’或‘某公’，古兄原本应该被称为玖台主，可玖台只有正五品，所以只能称‘古玖台主’…”
“可惜这些人叫着叫着，慢慢就把玖唤作九，也是明面上嘲讽古兄，他的玖台不过就是个空壳子，是台尾”
他顿了顿，又补了一句：
“不过古兄看得开，他自己也不计较”
周岐没有接话，他端起茶盏，目光透过符窗，落在广场上那扇“玖”字门上
玖门比其余八门都小，符玉比其余八门都新，门楣上的符印也比其余八门都暗淡，片刻后，他收回目光
沈知崖轻叹一声，接着说下去：
“品级之外，还有职务……修为，品级，职务，三者分开，这是抚仙楼的铁律，修为高不一定品级高，品级高不一定有实权，但在楼中，官高一级压死人，哪怕你修为再高，在这里只能盘着”
“当然，能坐从二品以上的，没有一个是弱者，不过…也有个别，总而言之，古楼没有你们看到的明面上那么简单”
他伸手在桌上虚画了一个圈：
“至于古楼的最高领袖大家都尊称为楼藏，正一品，统管古楼一切事务，今楼也跟古楼这边差不多”
“今楼设七阁，古楼设八台，虽然如今是九台，不过也没什么区别，今楼七阁以风，雷二阁为尊，金木水火土五阁次之”
“七阁每阁设阁主一人，副阁主一至二人，下设阁司，阁吏，阁尉若干，九台以甲，申二台为尊，其余七台次之，除了古兄的玖台，每台设台主一人，副台主一人，下设台丞，台吏，台尉若干”
“七阁主当纪符箓交易，八台主符道秘辛传承，不过这是明面上的分工，实际上，阁台之间的权力交叉远比这个复杂”
“今楼七阁的修士修为普遍更高，财力也更雄厚，我们古楼底蕴更深，但人丁相对单薄，两边各有所长，也各有所忌”
“差点忘了，仙楼中除了台主阁主，跟一些重要的司职之外，还有四个特殊的官职”
沈知崖竖起四根手指，逐一弯下
“庚机处——在古今二楼内设军事都统，正二品，掌武备征伐”
“司法刑律——由辛台风阁兼领，辛台台主，风阁阁主二人为总宪，从一品，掌监察刑罚”
“符政司——符台为中枢，设符台主，正二品，掌文书政令，审判提文，下设礼司，户司，功司”
“掌符机——炼符祭司，正三品，掌两楼所有符箓炼制”
四根手指全部弯下，他拍了拍桌面：
“这四个机构互相独立，也互相制衡，军事不能干预司法，行政不能插手炼符，各有各的权限，各有各的规矩”
“当然，规矩是死的，人是活的，他们之间，明争暗斗从来不少”
黄舜听得有些晕，小声问：
“那…未楼呢？”
沈知崖的手指顿了一下，他看了黄舜一眼，目光中闪过一丝意外的神色，随即恢复了温和的笑容：
“虽然不知小友从何得知关于未楼的信息，不过…未楼不在品级表内”
“未楼的人如果在今楼行走，会挂一个今楼的虚衔，如果在古楼行走，便会挂古楼的一个虚衔，比如某个台的副台主，或者某个阁的闲职，表面上品级不高，但暗地里权利很大”
他顿了顿，又补了一句：
“这些事，你在古楼待久了自然就知道了”
周岐放下茶盏
“讲得很清楚”
沈知崖笑着摇头：
“谈不上清楚，只是比外人多知道一些皮毛，真正的权力，不是靠品级表能画出来的，谁和谁是盟友，谁和谁是宿敌，哪一阁与哪一台有旧怨，哪一司被架空，这些东西，别说我了，古兄都未必全摸得透”
content_en:
The fifth grade is lower than a Fu Zhengshi from Fu Tai.
Shen Zhiya's voice was originally gentle, but suddenly there was an imperceptible coldness in his tone.
"In Gulou, there are rules for titles. People of rank 2 and above are generally called 'Master of a certain platform' or 'Master of a certain'. Brother Gu was originally supposed to be called Master of Jiutai, but Jiutai only has a rank of 5, so he can only be called 'Master of Gujiutai'..."
"It's a pity that these people are shouting and calling Jiu Jiu. They are also openly mocking Brother Gu. His Jiu Tai is just an empty shell, the tail end of the stage."
He paused and added:
"But Brother Gu is open-minded and doesn't care about it himself."
Zhou Qi didn't answer. He picked up the tea cup and looked through the talisman window, landing on the door with the word "9" in the square.
Jiumen is smaller than the other eight gates, the talisman is newer than the other eight gates, and the talisman on the lintel is darker than the other eight gates. After a moment, he looked away
Shen Zhiya sighed softly and continued:
"In addition to rank, there are positions... Cultivation, rank, and position are separated. This is the iron law of Fuxian Tower. High cultivation does not necessarily mean high rank, and high rank does not necessarily mean real power. But in the building, a higher official level will crush people to death. No matter how high your cultivation level is, you can only stay here."
"Of course, no one who can sit in the second grade or above is weak, but... there are some. In short, the ancient building is not as simple as you see on the surface."
He stretched out his hand and drew a circle on the table:
"As for the supreme leader of the ancient building, everyone respectfully calls him Lou Zang. He is the first grade and is in charge of all the affairs of the ancient building. The current building is similar to the ancient building."
"The current building has seven pavilions, and the ancient building has eight pavilions. Although it has nine pavilions now, there is no difference. The seven pavilions in the current building are dominated by the two pavilions of wind and thunder, followed by the five pavilions of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth."
"Each of the seven pavilions has one pavilion master, one or two deputy pavilion masters, and there are cabinet ministers, cabinet officials, and a number of cabinet lieutenants under them. Jiu Tai, Jia and Shen Er Tai are the most respected, and the other seven terraces follow. Except for Brother Gu's Jiu Tai, each platform has one master, one deputy master, and under it are Tai Cheng, Tai Li, and several Tai Wei."
"The masters of the seven pavilions are responsible for the talisman trade, and the masters of the eight pavilions are responsible for the secret inheritance of talismans. However, this is a division of labor on the surface. In fact, the intersection of power between the pavilions is far more complicated than this."
"The monks in the Seven Pavilions of the current building are generally higher in cultivation and have stronger financial resources. Our ancient building has a deeper foundation, but the population is relatively thin. Each has its own strengths and limitations."
"I almost forgot. In addition to the master of the pavilion and some other important positions, there are four special official positions in the Immortal Tower."
Shen Zhiya raised four fingers and bent them down one by one
"The Gengji Department - the military commander is set up on the second floor of the ancient and modern times, the second rank is in charge, and he is in charge of military preparations for conquests."
"Judicial and criminal law - Xintai Feng Pavilion is also headed by Xintai Pavilion Master and Feng Pavilion Master. They are the general constitution. They are the first rank and are in charge of supervising punishment."
"Fu Zhengsi - Fu Tai is the center. There is a Fu Tai master, the second rank, responsible for writing and administrative orders, judging and writing, and under it are the Rites Division, the Household Division, and the Gong Division."
"Talk Palm Machine - Talisman Refining Priest, Level 3, Palm Refining Talisman on the Second Floor"
All four fingers were bent, and he patted the table:
"These four institutions are independent of each other and check and balance each other. The military cannot interfere with the judiciary, and the administration cannot interfere with the refining of talismans. Each has its own authority and rules."
"Of course, rules are dead and people are alive. There have always been a lot of overt and covert fights between them."
Huang Shun felt a little dizzy and asked in a low voice:
"What about Weilou?"
Shen Zhiya paused his fingers, glanced at Huang Shun, a look of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then returned to his gentle smile:
"Although I don't know where the little friend got the information about Weilou, but... Weilou is not in the grade list."
"If people from Weilou walk in Jinlou, they will have a virtual title of Jinlou. If they walk in Gulou, they will have a virtual title of Gulou. For example, the deputy director of a certain station, or the idle position of a certain pavilion. On the surface, they are not of high rank, but secretly they have great power."
He paused and added:
"You will naturally know these things if you stay in the ancient building for a long time."
Zhou Qi put down the tea cup
“Made it very clear”
Shen Zhiya smiled and shook his head:
"It's not clear. I just know a little more than outsiders. Real power cannot be drawn by relying on rank tables. Who is an ally with whom, who is an old enemy with whom, which pavilion has an old grudge with which station, which department has been sidelined. Don't talk about me, Brother Gu may not be able to understand all these things."
